sections.shortTitle: Chairman and Speaker Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CHAIRMAN AND SPEAKER (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
CHAIRMAN AND
SPEAKER (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XL OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Chairman and Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 16th August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
16-8-2002.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Chairman and Speaker
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment of section 3, Act
LXXXIII of 1975.‑‑‑In the Chairman and Speaker (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (LXXXII of 1975), in section 3, for the
words "twenty thousand two hundred and fifty rupees" the words
"forty thousand rupees" shall be substituted.
